quote: a paraphrase generation model rewrites the canonical utterances to more natural and linguistically diverse alternatives
We propose a zero‑shot semantic parser ... without involving NLG tasks such as summarization or translation.
Central to our approach is a paraphrase generation model p(u → u′), which paraphrases a canonical utterance u to an alternative sentence u′ that is possibly more natural and linguistically diverse.

Measuring Language and Logical Gaps We measure the language mismatch between utterances in the paraphrased canonical (D par ) and natural (D nat ) data using perplexities of natural utterances in D nat given by a GPT-2 LM fine-tuned on D par .
We parameterize p(u → u) using generative pre‑trained LMs (BART Large), but we do not use LLMs as judges after generation.
Our evaluation relies on automatic denotation accuracy; no human annotators or crowdsourcing were employed.
